import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u094/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 5 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == 5 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            top_gaps = [x for x in range(left, right+1) if grid[top][x] == 0]
            if not top_gaps:
                continue
            gap = top_gaps[0]
            for y in range(top+1, bottom):
                for x in range(left+1, right):
                    if grid[y][x] == 0:
                        out[y][x] = 2
            inside_left, inside_right = left+1, right-1
            direction = -1 if gap > (inside_left + inside_right)/2 else 1
            if top > 0:
                x = gap
                while 0 <= x < w:
                    out[top-1][x] = 2
                    x += direction
    return out
'''
